context.transcript:
Everyone, as we get closer to the sales department's annual awards ceremony, I've assigned tasks for the awards committee to work on.
As the sales director, I'll personally create the awards and decide which members of the team will be recognized.
The task of purchasing prizes has always been difficult, so let me know if you need additional advice.
Also, as part of receiving approval to hold this event, our department was allocated some supplemental funding.
We'll use this funding to purchase catering for the event and buy the prizes.
context.transcript_translation:
各位，随着我们临近销售部门的年度颁奖典礼，我为奖项委员会分配了一些任务。
作为销售总监，我将亲自创建奖项并决定哪些团队成员将被表彰。
购买奖品这项任务一直很困难，所以如果你们需要额外的建议，请告诉我。
此外，为了获得举办此次活动的批准，我们的部门获得了一些补充资金。
我们将利用这笔资金为活动购买餐饮和购买奖品。
